be particularly alert in their own flight
preparations as well as activities at their localairports. This week incident with the Cessna182, which is flying into restricted airspace inWashington, D.C. clearly indicates that flightpreparation is more important than ever. TheC-182 was intercepted by military aircraft
after inadvertently straying into the restrictedairspace while attempting to avoid bad
weather.
Before taking off, the pilots should contactFAA Flight Service to receive the latest
information; know and understand all
applicable NOTAMs, and know where the
Temporary Flight Restrictions are. Also

cards.audioTextZh:
2002年6月21日，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）提醒所有飞行员，在进行自身的飞行准备工作以及在当地机场的活动时要格外警惕。本周发生的塞斯纳182飞机事件清楚地表明，飞行准备工作比以往任何时候都更加重要。这架塞斯纳182飞机在试图避开恶劣天气时，因疏忽误入了华盛顿特区的限制空域，随后遭到了军用飞机的拦截。

起飞前，飞行员应联系美国联邦航空管理局的飞行服务部门以获取最新信息；了解并熟知所有适用的航行通告（NOTAM），并且清楚临时飞行限制区域的位置。同时，在当地机场也要保持高度警惕，向当地有关部门报告可疑活动，并在离开前花时间妥善保管好飞机。至关重要的是，飞行员应继续以最高标准做好准备工作，履行职责并做出正确判断，并且也应鼓励其他人这样做。

cards.audioText:
On May 25,2002， a Boeing 747-200 aircraftperformed the flight from Taiwan Chung
Cheng airport to Hongkong international
airport, carrying 206 passengers and 19 crewmembers on board. It broke up and crashed atan altitude of 34,900 feet 23 miles northeastof Magong City in Penghu County, killing all
those on board. It is the deadliest air disasterin Taiwan. After careful investigation, scientistsfound the full story of the crash.About 20
years ago, the plane landed heavily at Kai TakAirport in Hong Kong and damaged the skinon its tail. After the damage to the tail, ChinaAirlines only covered the area with a piece ofaluminum plate similar to the damaged skin
and painted it. Instead of replacing the wholeskin in accordance with the maintenance
guidelines issued by Boeing. This cause a
buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For 22
years, maintenance crews had not noticed
anythirng unusual. After the split, the aircraftexperienced decompression disintegration.
According to the fuselage recovered after theaccident, the crack is at least 90.5 inches long,and studies have shown that the structure
could collapse if the crack is more than 58
inches in the air.
cards.audioTextZh:
2002年5月25日，一架波音747-200型飞机执行从台湾中正机场飞往香港国际机场的航班任务，机上搭载着206名乘客和19名机组人员。这架飞机在澎湖县马公市东北方向23英里、高度34900英尺的空中解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾地区最严重的空难事件。

经过仔细调查，科学家们查明了此次坠机事件的全貌。大约20年前，这架飞机在香港启德机场重重着陆，导致机尾蒙皮受损。机尾受损后，中华航空公司只是用一块与受损蒙皮相似的铝板覆盖了受损区域并进行了喷漆处理，而没有按照波音公司发布的维修指南更换整块蒙皮。这就导致该区域金属疲劳不断累积。22年来，维修人员一直没有发现任何异常情况。飞机出现裂缝后，发生了解压解体。

根据事故后回收的机身情况来看，裂缝至少有90.5英寸长，而且研究表明，在空中如果裂缝长度超过58英寸，飞机结构就可能会坍塌。

cards.audioText:
Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as
Jiuzhaigou Airport and Jiuhuang Airport, is anairport in Songpan County, Sichuan province.It is about 240km from Chengdu Shuangliu
International Airport, an important aviation
hub of Southwest China. It is one of the
highest airport in the world with an altitude of3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountainranges on both sides of the axis of the runway,and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peakof Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet
above the sea level. The terrain is complex andwind changes rapidly near the airport. So it isconsidered one of the most difficult airports
to fly to in China, aircraft must typically fly at afaster airspeed in order to takeoff or land, butthose who fly over here are also amazed by thebeautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation,
some passengers may experience symotomsof altitude sickness. This should be taken intoconsideration when planning to fly into or outof the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又称九寨沟机场、九黄机场，位于四川省松潘县。它距离中国西南地区重要的航空枢纽成都双流国际机场约240公里。该机场是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔达3448米。跑道中轴线两侧是令人叹为观止的山脉，其中最高的雪宝顶是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风向变化迅速。因此，它被认为是中国飞行难度最大的机场之一，飞机在起降时通常必须以更快的空速飞行，但飞过这里的人也会对这里的美丽景色惊叹不已。由于海拔较高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应症状。在计划进出该机场时，这一点应该加以考虑。

cards.audioText:
On December 7th 2016， a Pakistan
International Airlines ATR42, performing flightPakistan661 from Chitral to Islamabad reportedthe failure of the left hand engine.The crew
shut the engine down and continued towardsIslamabad descending, some time later, theydeclared Mayday and shortly afterwards radioand radar contact was lost. The aircraft was
unable to maintain heading and turned left
before impact with the ground. The airline
reported there were 42 passengers, 3 flight
crew, 2 cabin crew and a mechanics on boardof the aircraft, and all occupants of the aircraftperished in the crash. The investigation into thecrash showed that the aaccident was causedby technical factors and was not caused by
human error. The flight crew of Pakistan661
faced an very complex technical error, that hadnever occurred before. Due to maintenance
irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causingfurther damage, that made it impossible to
control the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
2016年12月7日，一架巴基斯坦国际航空公司的ATR42飞机执行从奇特拉尔飞往伊斯兰堡的巴基斯坦661号航班任务时，报告左侧发动机故障。机组人员关闭了该发动机，继续朝着伊斯兰堡下降飞行。一段时间后，他们发出了遇险信号（Mayday），不久之后，无线电和雷达联系均中断。

这架飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面之前向左转向。该航空公司报告称，机上有42名乘客、3名飞行机组人员、2名客舱机组人员以及1名机械师，机上所有人员都在此次坠机事故中遇难。

对此次坠机事故的调查显示，事故是由技术因素导致的，并非人为失误造成。巴基斯坦661号航班的机组人员面临着一个极其复杂的、此前从未出现过的技术故障。由于维护方面的不合规操作，一个涡轮叶片断裂，进而造成了进一步的损坏，使得飞机无法操控。

cards.audioText:

runway 26 at 07：18 local time when the aircraftwent around from very low height but did notclimb out to safety altitude, impacted terrainabout 1100 meters past the runway end and
went through a couple of houses of a village.All 4 crew on board the 747 as well as 35
people on the ground perished, 8 people onthe ground received injuries and were taken tohospitals.The cause of the Boeing 747 aircraftaccident was the missing control of the crewover the aircraft position in relation to the

The flight was conducted at night in the

cards.audioTextZh:
一架代表土耳其航空公司的麦卡戈货运航空公司（MyCargo Airlines）的波音747-400型货机，执飞从香港飞往比什凯克的TK-6491航班，机上有4名机组人员。当地时间07：18，这架飞机在对比什凯克26号跑道进行最后进近时，在很低的高度进行了复飞，但未能爬升至安全高度，在飞过跑道末端约1100米处撞击到了地面，并穿过了一个村庄的几栋房屋。

这架波音747飞机上的4名机组人员以及地面上的35人不幸遇难，8名地面人员受伤并被送往医院。这起波音747飞机事故的原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组人员未能正确掌控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。

此次飞行是在夜间进行的，当时的天气条件适合国际民用航空组织（ICAO）二类着陆标准。结果，机组人员没有及时进行复飞，并且飞机严重偏离了既定的进近图表，最终导致了可控飞行撞地事故的发生。

cards.audioText:
On April 29th 2013， a National Air Cargo
Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of US
Mobility Command, performing cargo flight
from Bagram to Dubai with 7 crew and cargo
consisting of 5 military vehicles, has crashed
shortly after takeoff. All 7 crew are reported
perished in the crash. Afghan Authorities
immediately denied claims that the crash of
a large civilian cargo aircraft was the result
of enemy activities. Several observers on
theground reported the National Air Cargo
Boeing 747 had just lifted off and was climbingthrough approximately 1200 feet when it's
nose sharply rose, the aircraft appeared to
have stalled and came down. According to
a listener on frequency, the crew reported
the aircraft stalled due to a possible load
shift. The National Transportation Safety Boarddetermined that the probable cause of this
accident was National Airlines's inadequate
procedures fo restraining special cargo loads,
which resulted in the loadmaster's improper
restraint of the cargo. The cargo moved afterand damaged hydraulic systems Nos.1 and
2 and horizontal stabilizer drive mechanism
components, rendering the airplane
uncontrollable.
cards.audioTextZh:
2013年4月29日，一架代表美国机动司令部的美国国家航空货运公司（National Air Cargo）的波音747-400型货机，搭载着7名机组人员和包括5辆军用车辆在内的货物，执行从巴格拉姆飞往迪拜的货运航班任务，在起飞后不久坠毁。据报道，机上7名机组人员全部在此次坠机事故中遇难。

阿富汗当局立即否认了这架大型民用货机坠毁是敌方活动所致的说法。地面上的几名目击者称，这架美国国家航空货运公司的波音747飞机刚刚起飞，在爬升至大约1200英尺高度时，机头急剧上扬，飞机似乎失速并坠落。据监听相关频率的人员称，机组人员报告称飞机可能因货物移位而失速。

美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国国家航空公司在约束特殊货物装载方面的程序不完善，导致货物装卸主管对货物的固定不当。货物移动后损坏了1号和2号液压系统以及水平安定面驱动机构部件，致使飞机失去控制。

cards.audioText:

Boeing 777-200 performing flight AA60 fromTokyo to Dallas with 269 people on board, wason approach to Dallas descending through
about 9000 feet when the aircraft encounteredmoderate turbulence.
According to National Transportation Safety
Board, as the flight began its descent into
KDF, the captain illuminated the seat belt signand made a public address announcement
reminding passengers to buckle up for the
remainder of the flight. Then theairplane
entered a band of small cumulus clouds and
experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate
turbulence.
When the turbulence was encountered, the
flight attendants were conducting their final
cabin safety checks, so 7 flight attendants
received minor injuries, one passenger, who
ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions toremain seated, injured his left ankle.
The aircraft continued for a landing on
Dallas airport runway 18R without further
incident about 12 minutes later. The flight
crew requested parameedics to meet the
airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger wastransported to the hospital, and the 7 flight
attendants were treated at the airplane and
released.
cards.audioTextZh:
2018年6月10日，一架美国航空公司的波音777-200型飞机执行从东京飞往达拉斯的AA60航班，机上载有269人。当飞机下降至约9000英尺高度，正在进近达拉斯时，遭遇了中度颠簸。

根据美国国家运输安全委员会的报告，当航班开始下降飞往达拉斯沃思堡国际机场（KDF）时，机长打开了安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客在航班剩余时间内系好安全带。随后，飞机进入了一片小块积云区域，并经历了10到15秒的中度颠簸。

遭遇颠簸时，空乘人员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名空乘人员受了轻伤。有一名乘客无视安全带指示灯以及要求其留在座位上的指示，结果左脚踝受伤。

大约12分钟后，这架飞机继续在达拉斯机场18R跑道降落，此后未再发生其他意外情况。机组人员要求医护人员在登机口迎接飞机。最后，那名受伤乘客被送往医院，7名受伤的空乘人员在飞机上接受了治疗后并无大碍。

cards.audioText:
On March 31st 2014,A Jetblue EmbraerERJ-190O performing flight B6-876 fromKingston to Fort Lauderdale with 98
passengers,encountered smoke in cockpitshortly after departure.
The aircraft was cleared to FL340 proceeding
northtowards the boundary with Havana and
was about to contact Havana Control when the
smell of smoke was detected by the cockpit
crew and after some discussion, the decision
was made to return to Kincgston. The crewdeclared an emergency to aïr traffic control,then the captain elected to hand over pilotflying duties to the first officer in order togive his atention to the overall management
of the situatior. Both pilots put on their
Oxygen masks, and begun the descent andpreparations to return to Kingston alnd they
made the decision to evacuate the aircraft on
therunway.
Finally the aircraft landed safely about 15minutes after takeoff. 6injured passengersreceived medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
2014年3月31日，一架捷蓝航空的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-190型飞机执飞从金斯敦飞往劳德代尔堡的B6-876航班，机上载有98名乘客，在起飞后不久驾驶舱内出现烟雾。

这架飞机获批爬升至340飞行高度层（FL340），向北朝着与哈瓦那的边界飞行。就在即将联系哈瓦那空管时，驾驶舱机组人员察觉到了烟雾气味。经过一番讨论后，机组决定返回金斯敦。机组人员向空中交通管制部门宣布了紧急情况，随后机长选择将操纵飞机的职责移交给副驾驶，以便自己能专注于整体情况的处理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降并为返回金斯敦做准备，他们还决定在跑道上疏散乘客。

最终，这架飞机在起飞约15分钟后安全着陆。6名受伤的乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText:
On August 11th 2016， a Jetblue Airbus A320-200, performing flight B6-429 from Boston, toSacramento with 146 passengers and 5 crew,was climbing from FL320 presumably to FL340
when the crew stopped the climb at FL334about 90nm southeast of Rlapid City, due toturbulence causing injuries to 24 passengersand 3 cabin crew. The aircraft diverted t RapidCity for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25minutes after stopping the climb at FL334. The
27 injured were taken to a hospital with minorinjuries. Passengers reported those not beltedinto their seats were lifted against the ceilingand then slammed down again. A number
of cabin ceiling panels received cracks. A
replacement A320 was dispatched to RapidCityand reached Sacramento with a delay of 7.5
hours. According to National TransportationSafety Board, probable cause of the occurrence
was an inadvertent encounter with convectiveturbulence while in cruise flight.
cards.audioTextZh:
2016年8月11日，一架捷蓝航空的空客A320-200型飞机执行从波士顿飞往萨克拉门托的B6-429航班，机上载有146名乘客和5名机组人员。当飞机从320飞行高度层（FL320）爬升，预计要升至340飞行高度层时，机组在拉皮德城东南约90海里处的334飞行高度层（FL334）停止了爬升，原因是气流颠簸导致24名乘客和3名客舱机组人员受伤。

在FL334高度层停止爬升约25分钟后，这架飞机备降拉皮德城，在32号跑道安全着陆。27名伤者被送往医院，均为轻伤。乘客们称，没有系好安全带的人被抛向天花板，然后又重重地摔下来。客舱的一些天花板镶板出现了裂缝。

一架替补的A320飞机被派往拉皮德城，最终晚点7.5小时抵达萨克拉门托。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的说法，这起事件的可能原因是飞机在巡航飞行时意外遭遇了对流性颠簸。

cards.audioText:
A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800，
performirng flight XG-3208 from Burgas to
Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintainFL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing
737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from

cards.audioTextZh:
. 一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。

机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。

两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。

cards.audioText:
On January 29th 2015， a Ryanair Boeing
737-800,performing FR-8592 from London
to Bergerac, was on NDB approach Y
to Bergerac's runway 28 in instrument
meteorological conditions. The aircraft
descended below minimum safe altitude whenit was handed off to tower. The approach
controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude
Warning and thee aircraft's EGPWS issued a
warning, too. The crew initiated a go-around
and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Thenthe crew positioned for another approach andlanded safely on runway 28 about 24 minutesafter aborting the first aproach. According
to the investigation, the incident occurred
while the aircraft performed an NDB approachwithout DME,probably without external visualreferences. Meanwhile, the first preparation
of the approach was probably incomplete or
imprecise. As a result, the late modification didnot permit the crew to agree on the guidancemodes. This resulted in confusion of the
captain as to the horizontal trajectory to be
followed by the aircraft. This state of confusionled him to request an early descent below thesafety altitude.
cards.audioTextZh:
2015年1月29日，一架瑞安航空的波音737-800型飞机执行从伦敦飞往贝杰拉克的FR-8592航班，在仪表气象条件下，采用无方向信标（NDB）进近方式，朝着贝杰拉克机场28号跑道进近。

当飞机移交给塔台管制时，它下降到了最低安全高度以下。进近管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS）也发出了警告。机组人员启动了复飞程序，飞机爬升至安全高度。然后机组人员重新调整位置准备再次进近，并在放弃第一次进近约24分钟后，安全降落在28号跑道上。

根据调查，这起事件发生在飞机在没有测距仪（DME）且可能没有外部目视参考的情况下进行无方向信标进近时。同时，第一次进近的准备工作可能不完整或不准确。因此，后期的修正没能让机组人员就引导模式达成一致。这导致机长对于飞机应遵循的水平航线感到困惑。这种困惑的状态使他要求飞机提前下降到安全高度以下。

cards.audioText:
On October 25th 2018， a Vueling Airbus
A320-200, performing flight VY-1431 from
Bilbao to Barcelona with 114 passengers and
6 crew, departed Bilbao's runway. At that
time, the left engine dropped two bonnets.
In the absence of any abnormal indicationss
and unaware of the separation, the crew
continued the flight to Barcelona for a safe
landing. Although a part of the engine cowlingbecame stuck in the left main gear, the gear
retracted normally after takeoff and extendedin Barcelona without prololems. The aircraft
received minor damage at the left main gear
and the left side of the fuselage where debrishit, however all persons on board disembarkednormally, no medical attention was needed.Theinvestigation has determined that the incidentwas caused by flying the airplane without
closing and properly latching the cowls on theairplane's left engine, which was in turn causedby an improper maintenance operation, and bythe incorrect performance of the walk-aroundcheck prior to the flight.
cards.audioTextZh:
2018年10月25日，一架伏林航空（Vueling）的空客A320-200型飞机执行从毕尔巴鄂飞往巴塞罗那的VY-1431航班，机上载有114名乘客和6名机组人员，从毕尔巴鄂机场跑道起飞。就在那时，左发动机的两个发动机罩脱落了。

由于没有任何异常指示，机组人员也未察觉到部件脱落，便继续飞往巴塞罗那并安全着陆。尽管有一部分发动机整流罩卡在了左主起落架上，但起落架在起飞后正常收起，在巴塞罗那着陆前也正常放下，没有出现问题。飞机的左主起落架以及机身左侧被碎片击中的部位受到了轻微损伤，不过机上所有人员都正常下机，无人需要医疗救治。

调查认定，这起事件的原因是飞机在左发动机整流罩未关闭且未正确锁好的情况下起飞，而这又是由不当的维修操作以及飞行前绕机检查执行不到位所导致的。

cards.audioText:

737-800, perfornning flight QF567 from
Sydney to Perth, had safely landed on Perth'srunway 03， vacated the runway via taxiway
J2 but taxied past the hold short point of
runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop
bar without an air traffic control clearance.
Another Qantas Boeing 737-800， performingfligInt QF582 from Perth to Sydney, was
accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 whenQF567 crossed the hold short line on taxiwayJ2, prompting tower to instruct QF582 to stopimmediately. QF582 rejecteed takeoff and
came to a stop near taxiway J2. The aircraftvacated the runway via taxiway A and returnedto the apron. The Australia Transport SafetyBureau report into the serious incident has
blamed taxiway design, flight crew distractionand incorrect mental model for the runway
incursion of another flight QF567. The ATSBsaid that soon after, the flight crew of QF567became aware of their position and stoppedtheir aircraft just before crossing the edge ofrunway 06 with QF582's wingtip passing about
15 meters from QF567's nose at low speed just

cards.audioTextZh:
2018年4月28日，一架澳航（Qantas）的波音737-800型飞机执行从悉尼飞往珀斯的QF567航班，已安全降落在珀斯机场的03号跑道上，随后通过J2滑行道脱离跑道，但滑行时越过了06号跑道的等待点，并且在未经空中交通管制许可的情况下穿过了亮起的停止标志杆。

另一架澳航的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从珀斯飞往悉尼的QF582航班，正在06号跑道上加速准备起飞，就在这时QF567航班越过了J2滑行道上的等待线，这促使塔台立即指示QF582航班停止。QF582航班中止了起飞，在J2滑行道附近停了下来。这架飞机随后通过A滑行道脱离跑道，返回停机坪。

澳大利亚运输安全局（Australia Transport Safety Bureau）对这起严重事件的报告指出，QF567航班发生跑道侵入事件的原因在于滑行道设计问题、机组人员注意力分散以及对跑道情况的错误心理认知模式。澳大利亚运输安全局表示，不久后，QF567航班的机组人员意识到了他们的位置，在即将越过06号跑道边缘前停下了飞机，而QF582航班的翼尖在即将停下前以低速从距离QF567航班机头约15米处掠过。

cards.audioText:
On Nov 20th 2013， an Atlas Air Boeing
747-400 Drealmlifter, performing freight flight5Y4241 from New York to Wichita McConnell
Airbase, with 2 crew, was on a GPS/RNAV
approach to McConnel Airport's runway 19L,
but unintentionally landed on runway 18 of
Wichita's Jabara Airport, and managed to
stop the aircraft on the runway. The crew
subsequently reported to be on the ground
and intending to vacate via taxiway D, to whichthe puzzled tower responded "stand by",
then reporting they were about 8nm from theaerodrome. The crew believed they had landedon Wichita's Beech Airport, the even more
puzzled tower controller replied "confirm you
landed at Beech Airport?", the crew requestedthe UNICOM frequency for Beech after the
tower had reported the tower was closed at
that time of the night. McConnell Tower thenreported the coordinates of Beech Airport,
the crew returned the coordinates, after whichtower identified the airport as Jabara accordingto those position data. In the meantime a
person on the ground had arrived at the
aircraft and told the crew the local frequency.
The aircraft and airport sustained no damage.
cards.audioTextZh:
2013年11月20日，一架阿特拉斯航空（Atlas Air）的波音747-400“梦想运输者”（Dreamlifter）货机，执行从纽约飞往威奇托麦康奈尔空军基地的5Y4241货运航班，机上有两名机组人员。该飞机当时正采用全球定位系统/区域导航（GPS/RNAV）进近方式，准备降落至麦康奈尔机场的19L跑道，但却意外降落在了威奇托贾巴拉机场的18跑道上，并且成功在跑道上使飞机停了下来。

随后，机组人员报告称已在地面，并打算通过D滑行道脱离跑道，对此感到困惑的塔台回应称“请稍等”，然后机组报告称他们距离机场大约8海里。机组人员认为他们降落在了威奇托的比奇机场，更加困惑的塔台管制员回应道“确认你们降落在了比奇机场？”。在塔台告知当晚那个时候比奇机场的塔台已经关闭后，机组人员索要了比奇机场的通用航空无线电台（UNICOM）频率。接着，麦康奈尔机场塔台报告了比奇机场的坐标，机组人员回复了坐标，之后塔台根据那些位置数据确定该机场是贾巴拉机场。与此同时，地面上有一个人来到了飞机旁，并告知了机组人员当地的频率。飞机和机场均未受到损坏。

cards.audioText:
A bmi Regional Embraer ERJ-145, performingflight BM1753 from Munich to Norrkoping with18 passegers and 3 crew, was self-positioningfor an ILS approach to Norrkoping's runway
27. The aircraft was cleared to descend to
2100 feet and cleared the approach to runway27. At the same time an ultralight aircraft
was operating below the controlled airspacein uncontrolled airspace performing a VFR
flight, the two aircraft were on different radiofrequencies. While still positioning to interceptthe localizer, the aircraft automatically turnedwest and began to descend, one pilot believedthey were capturing the glideslope, the otherpilot believed they were on localizer and aboveglide. The crew changed from automatic
glideslope coupling to vertical speed and

about the target on their TCAS screen and thealtitude of the Embraer. When the distance
reduced to 1 nautical mile horizontally and

cards.audioTextZh:
一架英国米德兰地区航空公司（bmi Regional）的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-145型飞机，执飞从慕尼黑飞往北雪平的BM1753航班，机上载有18名乘客和3名机组人员，当时正在自行调整位置，准备采用仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近北雪平机场的27号跑道。

这架飞机获得许可下降至2100英尺，并获批进近27号跑道。与此同时，一架超轻型飞机在管制空域下方的非管制空域内进行目视飞行规则（VFR）飞行，两架飞机使用的是不同的无线电频率。

在仍处于调整位置以截获航向道的时候，这架飞机自动向西转弯并开始下降。一名飞行员认为他们正在截获下滑道，而另一名飞行员则认为他们处于航向道上且在下滑道上方。机组人员将自动下滑道耦合模式改为垂直速度模式，并增加了下降率以重新截获下滑道。

随后，机组人员对他们的空中交通防撞系统（TCAS）屏幕上的目标以及这架ERJ-145飞机的高度提出了疑问。当两机的水平距离缩小至1海里、垂直距离缩小至200英尺时，这架ERJ-145飞机的防撞系统发出了避让建议，机组人员启动了复飞程序。

这架飞机重新调整位置进行再次进近，并在大约10分钟后安全着陆。

cards.audioText:

cockpit. The commander declared PAN andcontinued for a safe landing in Glasgow.Theprobable cause of the incident was that theco-pilot experienced anxiety which developed
into an anxiety attack during the approach to
Glasgow. Thee commander, ATC and cabincrew worked together effectively to achievea safe single pilot landing and to get medicalhelp for the co-pilot. The opportunity for the

cards.audioTextZh:
2018年9月30日，一架易捷航空（Easyjet）的空客A319型飞机执行从伦敦飞往格拉斯哥的U2-211航班，机上载有148名乘客和6名机组人员。在飞机朝着格拉斯哥下降的过程中，担任操纵飞行员的副驾驶身体状况不适宜继续飞行，便将飞机控制权移交给机长，随后离开了驾驶舱。

机长宣布了“PAN”（表示遇到紧急情况但尚未达到最危急程度的信号），并继续安全降落在格拉斯哥。这起事件的可能原因是，副驾驶在进近格拉斯哥的过程中产生了焦虑情绪，进而发展成了焦虑发作。

机长、空中交通管制人员以及客舱机组人员进行了有效协作，成功实现了单飞行员安全着陆，并为副驾驶提供了医疗救助。如果副驾驶能更早报告自己不适宜执行任务，副驾驶与机长之间能进行更有效的沟通，或者副驾驶能利用同事提供的支持，或者借助官方援助项目之一，那么这起事件发生的可能性或许会降低。

cards.audioTextZh:
一架载有359人的亚洲航空（AirAsia）空客A330-300型飞机，当时正在珀斯西南约200海里处、380飞行高度层（FL380）的航路上飞行。随后，其左侧发动机的一个叶片发生断裂。发动机吸入了该叶片，导致发动机核心部分受到严重损坏，并引发了剧烈振动。

cards.audioTextZh:
一架东星航空（Eastar Jet）的波音737-800型飞机，执行从韩国飞往日本的航班任务，获得许可进近03L跑道。然而，这架飞机却对准了03R跑道。但03R跑道上有一辆车辆占用。飞机在很低的高度进行了复飞。随后，它重新调整位置，准备再次进近03L跑道。最终，在复飞约9分钟后，这架飞机安全降落在了03L跑道上。

日本运输安全委员会发布了最终报告，解释了这起严重事件的可能原因。在这起严重事件中，极有可能是因为飞机机长认错了跑道，所以他对准了有一辆检查车辆正在行驶的另一条跑道进行进近。

cards.audioText:

on board. When the aircraft was climbing

immediate return to London. The crelw

cards.audioTextZh:
一架法国航空公司（Air France）的空客A319-100型飞机，执行从伦敦飞往巴黎的航班，机上载有136人。当飞机爬升至230飞行高度层（FL230）时，机组人员戴上了氧气面罩，发出了遇险信号（Mayday），并请求立即返回伦敦。机组人员表示，他们怀疑飞机上有火灾，随后，他们报告称驾驶舱内有烟雾。

cards.audioText:
A Scoot Airbus A319-100, performing flightPhilippines to Singapore with 129 people onboard, was descending towards Singapore
when the flight crew donned their oxygen
masks. Declared PAN PAN, reporting excessivecabin altitude and initiated an emergency
descent to 9000 feet. The aircraft continuedto Singapore for a safe landing on runway
20C about 23 minutes after declaring PAN
PAN. The likely cause of the excessive cabin
altitude was a corruption of LFE that is
landing field elevation in the CPC. The CPC
manufacturer believed that the corruption
arose from a fatigue solder joint on the CPCcircuit board. There had been past occurrencesof excessive caabin altitude that were causedby a corruption of LFE value in the CPC, of
which one was determined to have likely beencaused by a fatigue solder joint, similar to thisoccurrence.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架酷航（Scoot）的空客A319-100型飞机，搭载着129名乘客，执行从菲律宾飞往新加坡的航班任务。在飞机朝着新加坡下降的过程中，机组人员戴上了氧气面罩，发出了“PAN PAN”（表示紧急情况但情况尚不太危急的信号），报告客舱高度过高，并启动了紧急下降程序，降至9000英尺高度。

在发出“PAN PAN”信号约23分钟后，这架飞机继续飞往新加坡，并安全降落在20C跑道上。客舱高度过高的可能原因是客舱压力控制器（CPC）中的着陆场海拔（LFE）数据出现错误。客舱压力控制器的制造商认为，该数据错误是由客舱压力控制器电路板上的一个焊点疲劳导致的。

过去也曾发生过客舱高度过高的情况，原因也是客舱压力控制器中的着陆场海拔数值错误，其中有一次经判定很可能是由焊点疲劳引起的，与此次事件的情况类似。

cards.audioText:
On 26 June 2006， a British Airways Airbus
A320-20O pushed back using a towbarless
tractor at London Heathrow Airport. But
that unit was disconnected from the aircraft.
After receiving taxi clearance from ATC, the
aircraft started moving under its own power,
and shortly afterwards, collided with the
tractor that had just performed the pushback.Both the right engine of the aircraft and the
tractor were damaged. The investigation
report published in May 2017 stated, that theprimary causal factor of the accident, was theheadset operator giving the "all clear" signal
to the flight crew, before the tractor had
been repositioned to a safe distance from theaircraft. Contributory factors were the co-pilotfailing to see the tractor. What's more, the
fact that the tractor didn't drive away after theaircraft began to taxi was also a reason for thisaccident.
cards.audioTextZh:
2006年6月26日，一架英国航空公司的空客A320-200型飞机在伦敦希思罗机场使用无拖把牵引车进行后推操作。但牵引车与飞机脱开了连接。

在得到空中交通管制（ATC）的滑行许可后，飞机开始依靠自身动力移动，不久之后，就与刚刚完成后推操作的牵引车相撞。飞机的右发动机和牵引车均遭到损坏。

2017年5月发布的调查报告称，这起事故的主要原因是，在牵引车还未重新移动到离飞机安全距离之外时，头戴式耳机操作员就向机组人员发出了“一切正常”的信号。

促成事故发生的因素包括副驾驶没有看到牵引车。此外，在飞机开始滑行后，牵引车没有驶离这一情况也是导致这起事故的一个原因。

cards.audioText:
On August 1st 2018, an Aeromexico ConnectERJ'190 from Durango to Mexico rejected
takeoff from Durango's runway 03 because
of adverse weathel at about 15：15 local time.
The aircraft veered left off the runway, overranthe end of the runway and burst into flames
in viewing distance of the airport's apron. Theaircraft was destroyed, there were no fatalities,2 people received serious injuries and 83
people received minor injuries. Some peoplewith injuries were taken to a local hospital.
The airline stated there were 99 passengers
including 2 infants and 4 crew on board. Theaircraft was 10 years old and had operated forAeromexico since 2014. The local governor
reported the aircraft was about to take off
when the aircraft suffered an accicdent.
According to flight data recorder as well as
cockpit voice recorder, the pilots did a good
job to bring the plane down, which preventedthings from worse to catastrophe.
cards.audioTextZh:
2018年8月1日，当地时间约15点15分，一架墨西哥航空连接公司（Aeromexico Connect）的ERJ190型飞机执行从杜兰戈飞往墨西哥城的航班任务，由于恶劣天气，在杜兰戈机场03跑道上中断起飞。

飞机向左偏离跑道，冲出跑道末端，并在机场停机坪可视范围内起火燃烧。这架飞机损毁严重，所幸无人员死亡，2人受重伤，83人受轻伤。一些受伤人员被送往当地医院。

该航空公司称，机上有99名乘客（包括2名婴儿）和4名机组人员。这架飞机已服役10年，自2014年起为墨西哥航空公司执飞任务。当地州长报告称，飞机在即将起飞时发生了事故。

根据飞行数据记录器以及驾驶舱语音记录器显示，飞行员们采取了有效措施使飞机停下，避免了事态恶化成一场灾难。

cards.audioText:
A Delta Airlines Airbus 330， performing a
flight from New York to Paris， was enroute atFL380 about 700nm southwest of Reykjavik airport， Iceland when the crewdecided to divert to Iceland， reporting with
left hand engine failure. The crew requestedto descend to FL320 and set course for
Reykjavik. The diversion was approved by
Oceanic Control within a minute， however， therequest to descent took more than 15 minutesdue to a lot of traffic around that needed
to be moved out. The aircraft continued to
maintain FL380 in the meantime. Finally， theaircraft descended to FL290 and landed safelyon Iceland about 2 hours after the decision todivert. After the landing， another aircraft wassent from Amsterdam to fly the 96 passengersand cargo from lceland to Paris. According
to the investigation， the crew attempte to
move the thrust lever back and forth when
the engine started to vibrate， but this resultedin the ergine stalling a number of times. Thecrew thus declared emergency and diverted toIceland on single engine.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架达美航空公司（Delta Airlines）的空客330型飞机，执行从纽约飞往巴黎的航班任务。当飞机在冰岛雷克雅未克机场西南约700海里处、处于380飞行高度层（FL380）的航路上时，机组人员决定备降冰岛，报告称左侧发动机出现故障。

机组人员请求下降到320飞行高度层（FL320），并设定飞往雷克雅未克的航线。大洋管制部门在一分钟内就批准了此次备降，然而，由于周围空域有大量航班，需要先进行调配，所以下降请求过了15分钟才获批。在此期间，飞机继续保持在380飞行高度层。

最终，这架飞机下降到290飞行高度层（FL290），并在决定备降约2小时后安全降落在冰岛。飞机降落后，另一架从阿姆斯特丹派出的飞机将机上的96名乘客和货物从冰岛运往巴黎。

根据调查，当发动机开始出现振动时，机组人员试图来回移动推力杆，但这导致发动机多次失速。于是，机组人员宣布了紧急情况，并以单发动机状态备降冰岛。

cards.audioText:
A visual approach is an ATC authorization foraircrafit on IFR flight plan to proceed visually
to the airport, even to the landing. It is not aninstrument approach procedure, and there is
no missed approach segment. Even when an
aircraft is being vectored for an instrument
approach, controllers may initiate or pilots
may request a visual approach provided the
pilot subsequently reports the airport or
runway in sight. Before clearing an aircraft for
a visual approach, controllers should ensure
that weather conditions at the airport are VFR,and they need resolve potential conflicts with
all other aircraft. The pilot must, at all times,
have either the airportor the preceding aircraftin sight. This approach must be authorized
and under the control of the appropriate air
traffic control facility. Reported weather at theairport must be ceiling ator above 1000ft, andvisibility of 3 miles or greater. An aircraft unableto complete visual approach shall be handled
as any"go around", and appropriate separationmust be provided.
cards.audioTextZh:
目视进近是空中交通管制（ATC）对处于仪表飞行规则（IFR）飞行计划中的飞机的一种许可，允许其以目视方式飞往机场，甚至直接着陆。它并非一种仪表进近程序，且不存在复飞航段。

即使一架飞机正按引导进行仪表进近，只要飞行员随后报告已看到机场或跑道，管制员也可以发起、或者飞行员可以请求进行目视进近。在批准一架飞机进行目视进近之前，管制员应确保机场的天气状况符合目视飞行规则（VFR），并且他们需要解决与所有其他飞机之间可能存在的冲突。

飞行员在任何时候都必须能够看到机场或前方的飞机。这种进近方式必须得到相应空中交通管制机构的批准并处于其管控之下。机场所报告的天气状况必须是：云底高度达到或高于1000英尺，能见度为3英里或更远。

一架无法完成目视进近的飞机应按照任何“复飞”情况来处理，并且必须为其提供适当的间隔。

cards.audioText:
An aircraft was ready for taxi and it was cleared to taxi to the departure runway holding point.It was also approved to cross an inner and outer taxiway en route, so the pilot released the parking brake.When the aircraft started to move,the pilot saw a B747 on his left,and the B747 went faster than him.The controller immediately instructed the pilot to hold short and give way to the B747 but
the pilot only paid attention to the B747 on his left,so he didn't follow the
instruction and continued to move to the threshold.The aircraft stopped when the First Officer warned "stop!"and the pilot applied the brakes at once.When a pilot made errors,the First Officer played important role.Without the First
Officer,their aircraft would have probably collided with another aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 树袋熊01，音频都一模一样，就不重录了
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机在准备滑行，并且得到滑行到等待点的许可。滑行路线允许穿过内侧和外侧 滑行道.,所以飞行员松开了刹车。飞机开始移动后，飞行员看到左侧有一架波音747, 这架波音747的速度更快。管制员立刻指挥飞机等待给波音747让路，但飞行员只注意 到左侧的波音747,所以他并没有听到指令，而是继续向入口移动。副驾驶发出警告说： "停下!"于是飞行员立刻进行刹车。飞行员出现错误时，副驾驶的作用很重要。如果不 是副驾驶，他们的飞机很可能与另一架飞机相撞。

cards.audioText:
A flight flew from Beijing to Shanghai.During the flight,the aircraft requested
radar vectors to Shanghai Approach for losing some altitude.The inbound course was 157°and altitude was 3000 feet.The controller gave the instruction,"Fly
heading 130°,intercept LOC Runway 16",but after following the instruction,
TCAS showed several targets.Then the ATC gave another instruction,"Do not cross LOC course,for separation".The pilot responded,"Wilco".When they
captured,they reported to the ATC,but the ATC said"I told you,do not capture LOC course."Both the pilots were not sure about the ATC's meaning but
they continued to approach and landed safely.After the flight,the flight crew discussed about the ATC instruction,and they thought the instruction could be understood differently.It was a fortune that they landed safely,so the ATC must use standard words to give clear instructions when they were working.
cards.referenceText: 树袋熊02，音频都一模一样，就不重录了
cards.audioTextZh:
一架飞机从北京飞往上海。途中，飞机向上海进近申请雷达引导下降高度。向台航道 157°,高度3000英尺。管制员给出指令："航向130°,切入跑道16航道。"但完成指令后， TCAS显示几个活动目标。然后ATC给出另一指令："不要穿过航道，保持间隔。"飞行
员回复："照办。"飞机截获航道时，飞行员向ATC报告，但ATC说："我说的是，不要截 获航道。"两位飞行员无法确定ATC 的意图，但他们继续进近并安全着陆。飞行结束后， 机组对ATC 的指令进行讨论，他们认为指令可以有不同的理解方式。幸运的是飞机能 够安全着陆，所以ATC 在工作时必须使用标准用语来给出指令。

cards.audioText:
At 1:30 pm local time,the crew members checked in for a long distance flight,
and the aircraft took off after 3:30 pm.Another 2 hours later,the operation asked the aircraft to return back to the airport of departure because of technical fault, so the captain had to tell passengers about what was going on via PA.After
landing,the flight crew had worked for about 8 hours,and their work should be taken over under the circumstances,but the operation told them that they had to change to operate another shorter and delayed flight.It was already eight o' clock after the aircraft landed.Three of the crew decided not to operate the flight and I supported their opinion.Two replacement crew members arrived at the
aircraft and they still needed to operate their new flight.At about ten o'clock, everything was ready for departure.The crew members hadn't had any formal meal since then.
cards.referenceText: 树袋熊03，音频都一模一样，就不重录了
cards.audioTextZh:
当地时间下午1:30，机组成员到机场报到，为一次长途飞行做准备，飞机在下午3:30之后起飞。约2小时后，由于技术故障，运行控制部门要求飞机返回出发机场，机长只得通过客舱广播向乘客说明情况。

飞机着陆时，机组已经工作约8小时，按当时情况本应由其他机组接替，但运行控制部门却通知他们，必须改为执行另一个航程较短但已经延误的航班。飞机落地时已是晚上8点。3名机组成员决定不再执行该航班，我支持他们的决定。

两名替换机组成员随后抵达飞机，但原机组仍需执行他们新分配的航班。到晚上10点左右，一切离场准备就绪。自报到以来，机组成员一直没有吃过一顿正式的饭。

cards.audioText:
In 2005,direct charter flight between Chinese mainland and Taiwan was opened. Departure and destination airports included Beijing,Guangzhou,Shanghai and Taipei.It was the first ever non-stop,round-trip charter flight across the Taiwan Straits in 56 years.It was also the first time since 1949 that a mainland jetliner
flew for Taiwan on normal commercial flight.
The first mainland aircraft to take off was CCA1087 which departed from the Beijing Capital Airport at 8:00 am on Saturday.All the 88 passengers on board were Taiwan business people and their families.During the Spring Festival,they went back home for traditional family reunion.
The first mainland aircraft to land was CSZ3097.It only took 90 minutes for all the 242 passengers on board to fly from Guangzhou to Taipei.
After nearly 4 hours of non-stop flight,a charter plane of Taiwan-based China Airlines landed in Beijing.The flight time was much shorter than the same trip in the past.Previous flight would take about 10 hours,and passengers had to transit in Hong Kong or Macao.
The direct charter flight will provide convenience to people on the mainland and Taiwan.

2005
cards.audioTextZh:
2005年，中国大陆与台湾之间开通了直航包机。出发和到达机场包括北京、广州、上海和台北。这是56年来两岸首次开通不经停往返包机，也是自1949年以来，大陆喷气式客机首次执行飞往台湾的正常商业航班。

最先从大陆起飞的是国航CCA1087航班，飞机于星期六上午8:00从北京首都机场起飞。机上88名乘客全部是台湾商务人士及其家属，他们在春节期间返乡与家人团聚。

最先抵达台湾的是南航CSZ3097航班。机上242名乘客从广州飞往台北，全程仅用90分钟。

经过近4小时不经停飞行，一架台湾中华航空公司的包机在北京着陆。与过去相同行程相比，飞行时间大幅缩短；以往需要约10小时，乘客还必须在香港或澳门中转。

直航包机将为大陆和台湾民众往来提供便利。

cards.audioText:
The breakup of China Airlines Flight 611,a Boeing 747-200,has drawn
international attention because it comes at a time of increasing concern over
how long older jets can remain airworthy.Some research has suggested that
metal fatigue may be a particular problem in planes that are used regularly in
very warm,humid places like Taipei and Hong Kong.But Boeing maintains that with proper maintenance,aircraft aging should not be a problem.The flight data recorder shows that the plane began gaining altitude at a significantly faster
rate in the 27 seconds before the plane broke apart,although the extra gain in
altitude was well within the plane's design limits.The plane was supposed to be leveling off then as it approached its cruising altitude of 35,000 feet.According to the examination of the wreckage,investigators analyzed that there's no evidence of an explosion or pilot error.
cards.audioTextZh:
中华航空611号航班是一架波音747-200，其空中解体事件引起国际社会关注，因为人们正越来越担忧老旧喷气式飞机能够保持适航状态多长时间。一些研究认为，在台北、香港等炎热潮湿地区频繁运行的飞机尤其容易出现金属疲劳问题。但波音公司坚持认为，只要维护得当，飞机老化不应成为问题。

飞行数据记录器显示，在飞机解体前27秒内，飞机的爬升率明显增大，不过增加的高度仍完全处于飞机的设计限制范围内。当时飞机接近35,000英尺巡航高度，本应正在改平。根据对残骸的检查，调查人员认为没有证据显示发生过爆炸，也没有证据表明飞行员操作失误。

cards.audioText:
One day,an accident happened because an aircraft was guided improperly by a marshaller when parking.
The marshaller first guided the aircraft to a gate.When the aircraft was near the stop line,the marshaller gave a premature crossed wands signal which means
stopping taxiing,so the aircraft was stopped abruptly.The pilot set the parking brake and released the seatbelt sign.Unexpectedly,the marshaller showed the
separated wands again and stopped them a little forward of the point.He did not give a clear signal,and the sudden stop caused fatigue and a medical emergency of 2 passengers.When the marshaller was asked about the signal,he said he did not give the signal.Anyway,it was not a good guidance but the final position of the aircraft was proper.Luckily there were no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
一天，一架飞机在停靠机位时因信号员引导不当而发生事件。

信号员先引导飞机滑向机位。飞机接近停止线时，信号员过早给出指挥棒交叉信号，表示停止滑行，飞机因此突然停下。飞行员设置停留刹车并关闭安全带指示灯。出乎意料的是，信号员随后又给出指挥棒分开信号，让飞机继续向前移动一点后才再次停下。

信号员的指令不清晰，飞机突然停止导致两名乘客身体不适，其中出现医疗紧急情况。被问及相关信号时，信号员否认自己发出过该信号。无论如何，这次引导并不规范，不过飞机最终停靠位置正确。所幸机上没有人员受伤。

cards.audioText:
When a B747 was climbing out,its No.1 engine failed.The failure caused the aircraft to yaw the heading about 20 degrees from the original.
The Primary Engine Display showed that the thrust was zero,the engine
indications were all red,and the temperature was exceeding 680℃.The aircraft
had autopilot disconnection,then it suddenly yawed and the heading deviated 10 degrees.The pilot immediately leveled off the aircraft so that he could check the engine.Then he confirmed that No.1 engine was failed.
The EGT temperature was still high when all proper procedures were done.So the pilot pulled out the engine fire lever to secure the engine and completed the checklist.Because of the landing weight requirements,the aircraft had to dump fuel before landing.Then the pilot requested radar vector to the fuel dumping area and started dumping fuel at 8000 feet.During the 35 minutes of dumping, the controller asked other aircraft to avoid the dumping area.At last,they made an auto landing then taxied to the gate safely.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架B747 在上升，此时1号发动机失效。故障导致飞机从原航线偏航20度。
主发动机显示器显示推力为零，发动机故障显示亮起，温度超过680℃。飞机的自动驾 驶断开，然后飞机突然偏航10度。飞行员立刻平飞来检查发动机，然后飞行员确定1号 发动机已失效。
所有程序全部完成后，EGT 温度仍然很高，所以飞行员拉出发动机灭火手柄来保护发 动机，并完成检查单。由于着陆重量限制，飞机着陆前必须放油。飞行员请求雷达引 导到放油区，然后在8000英尺高开始放油。放油持续了35分钟，这期间管制员指挥其 它飞机避开放油区。最后，飞机自动着陆并安全滑到停机位。

cards.audioText:
A B737 was cleared to taxi to holding point of runway 29 while the pilot saw the landing lights of A320 on landing rollout at the opposite end of the runway.A320 had landed on runway 11 and a conflict was nearly to happen.In order to exit the runway quickly,the pilot of B737 turned 180 degrees.At the same time,tower
called and gave him instruction to vacate the runway.The B737 almost collided with A320 but there were nothing wrong with the two aircraft.The cause of this possible accident was that the two operations were conducted in both directions on runway 11/29.A320 was landing on runway 11 while B737 was holding short of runway 29 and waiting for ATC clearance at the same time.Then the tower called them and instructed them to fly SH-01 departure and climb 7000 feet when
airborne,but they considered it as a clearance,so they began to taxi onto the
runway.At that time,the tower and ground were combined.The pilot had called the tower twice without receiving any response,so he was not sure whether the aircraft had landed.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架波音737获准滑行至29号跑道等待点。此时飞行员看到一架空客A320在跑道另一端亮着着陆灯，正在着陆滑跑；该A320是在11号跑道着陆，两机险些发生冲突。为了尽快退出跑道，波音737飞行员将飞机转向180度。与此同时，塔台呼叫并指令其脱离跑道。波音737与空客A320险些相撞，但两架飞机均未受损。

这起险情的原因，是11/29号跑道同时进行相反方向运行：空客A320在11号跑道着陆，而波音737在29号跑道外等待管制许可。随后塔台呼叫波音737，向其发布SH-01离场程序以及离地后爬升至7,000英尺的指令，但机组把这段指令误认为进入跑道的许可，因此开始滑入跑道。

当时塔台和地面管制席位合并运行。此前飞行员曾两次呼叫塔台但都没有收到回应，因此无法确定那架飞机是否已经着陆。

cards.audioText:
The ATC cleared an aircraft to take off,but shortly after take-off,two of the flight attendants smelled something burning.They immediately informed the purser while found that the captain had already contacted the Tower and requested
airport assistance.Some passengers felt panic when they saw the smoke in the cabin.
Soon captain told passengers about the situation via PA.A few minutes later,
dense smoke spread all over the cabin and some passengers suffered from smoke inhalation.At the same time,the flight attendants consulted their emergency
checklist and tried to keep the passengers in order.
The aircraft finally returned to the departure airport.Fire trucks arrived
and ambulances were ready to meet them at the apron.Fortunately,all the
passengers were safely evacuated and got effective first aid.After inspection,the cause of the accident was clear.It was an electrical fire in the cockpit.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架飞机从ATC 处得到起飞许可，但在起飞后不久，两名乘务员闻到烧焦的味道，他 们立刻通知了乘务长，同时发现机长已经联系塔台并请求机场援助。 一些乘客看到客 舱有烟开始感到恐慌。
很快，机长通过广播将情况告知乘客。几分钟后，客舱内布满浓烟，有些乘客吸入了 烟尘。此时，乘务员完成紧急检查单并尽力维持乘客的秩序。
飞机最终返回出发机场，消防车和救护车在机坪等待飞机。幸运的是，乘客们全部被 安全撤离并得到急救。经检查，事故原因是由于驾驶舱发生电气火灾。

cards.audioText:
In 1986,a little girl named Crystal Grant living in Memphis,Tennessee got a liver disease and needed a liver transplant.Her family got information that a liver
source became available but she must fly to Houston,Texas,she would be able to take the medical treatment.Before departure,an accident happened that the plane blew a couple of tires and ran off the runway into a fence while taking off. At the same time,a Coca-Cola corporate jet had just arrived at the airport
carrying their CEO,and the pilot who saw the accident heard the experience of Crystal.Then the pilot briefed the CEO about the story.After visiting Crystal,the CEO decided to take her to Houston by his corporate jet.
Meanwhile,the liver which Crystal needed was in San Diego,California,but the flight to transport the liver got failed.
The CEO asked the pilot if they could fly to San Diego to pick up the liver first, but found that they would not have enough time for the transplant.
Then the CEO contacted the governor of California and explained the situation. Finally,the governor dispatched an F-18 fighter jet to safely transport the liver
container to Houston.Everything ran smoothly and the little girl got a successful transplant.

1986
cards.audioTextZh:
1986年，家住田纳西州孟菲斯的小女孩Crystal Grant患有肝病，需要接受肝脏移植。家人得知已有可用肝源，但她必须飞往得克萨斯州休斯顿才能接受治疗。出发前，她原本要乘坐的飞机在起飞时爆了数个轮胎，冲出跑道并撞上围栏。

与此同时，一架搭载可口可乐公司首席执行官的公务机刚刚抵达机场。公务机飞行员目睹了事故并听说Crystal的经历，随后向首席执行官讲述此事。首席执行官探望Crystal后，决定用自己的公务机送她前往休斯顿。

Crystal需要的肝脏位于加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，但原计划运输肝脏的航班未能成行。首席执行官询问飞行员能否先飞往圣迭戈取肝脏，却发现这样将赶不上移植手术。

首席执行官随后联系加利福尼亚州州长并说明情况。最终，州长派出一架F-18战斗机，将装有肝脏的容器安全运至休斯顿。整个过程进展顺利，小女孩成功接受了移植手术。

cards.audioText:
A man was on a flight from Seattle to San Francisco,but along the way,the
plane stopped unexpectedly in Sacramento.The flight attendant explained the situation and told passengers that they could get off the aircraft for a walk within 50 minutes before the plane re-boarded.
Passengers got off the plane in succession except one person.When the man
walked by the only person on board he could tell the person was a blind man.
Because the man was wearing sunglasses and a seeing eye dog was lying
quietly underneath the seat in front of him.The blind man had flown this flight frequently because the pilot could call him by name.The pilot asked,"Keith,we' re in Sacramento for almost an hour.Would you like to get off and stretch your legs?The blind man said no but he asked the pilot if he could take his dog for a walk.
What the pilot did not know was,all the people in the gate area came to a
complete standstill when they saw him,because the pilot got off the plane with a seeing eye dog and a pair of sunglasses on.It caused a panic between passengers that they thought the pilot was a blind man.They not only tried to change
planes,but also wanted to change airlines!It took time for the pilot and flight
attendants to explain to passengers and calm them down.Later the aircraft took off again.
cards.audioTextZh:
一位男士乘坐飞机从西雅图飞往旧金山，途中飞机突然在萨克拉门托降落。乘务员向 乘客解释了情况，并告诉他们可以在起飞前下飞机活动50分钟。乘客们依次下飞机，
但有一位乘客没走。当男士经过这位乘客时，他注意到这位乘客是盲人。因为他戴着 墨镜，一只导盲犬安静地躺在他前方的座位下。这位盲人肯定经常乘坐这趟航班，因 为飞行员能够直接叫出他的名字。飞行员问他："Keith, 我们将在萨克拉门托停留一小 时，你想下飞机活动一下吗?"这位盲人拒绝了，但他问飞行员是否可以带他的导盲犬 散个步。
但飞行员不知道的是，门口的乘客在看到他时全都停下了，因为他在下飞机时戴着墨 镜并牵着一只导盲犬。这引发了乘客们的恐慌，他们以为飞行员是个盲人。乘客们不 仅想更换航班，而且还想更换航空公司!飞行员和乘务员花了一段时间向乘客解释情 况并让大家冷静下来，之后飞机再次起飞了。

cards.audioText:
On a flight,a middle-aged,well-off white South African Lady was not satisfied
with her seat for she found herself sitting next to a black man.She called the
flight attendant over and asked to change to another seat.The attendant wanted to know the reason,which made the woman more irritable."Can't you see?You' ve sat me next to a kaffir.I can't possibly sit next to this disgusting human.Find me another seat!"
The flight attendant found it hard to deal with because the flight was very full,
but she told the woman that she would go and check to see if there was any seat available in club or first class.
A few minutes later the attendant returned with good news.Economy and club are both full,but there were one seat in first class.When the attendant delivered the news,the lady cannot help but looked at the people around her with a smug and self-satisfied grin.
Then the attendant continued,"We don't make this kind of upgrade as usual,
however,I just got special permission from the captain and he felt that it was
outrageous for our passenger to be forced to sit next to such an obnoxious
person."She then turned to the black man sitting next to the woman and said, "So if you'd like to get your things,sir,I have your seat ready for you."
The surrounding passengers all stood and gave a standing ovation,the black guy walks up to the front of the plane.
cards.audioTextZh:
一次飞行中，有位来自南非、富有的中年白人女士对自己的座位不满意，因为她发现 自己的座位在一位黑人男士旁边，她向乘务员要求换座位。乘务员询问换座位的原因， 这让她更加烦躁：“你看不到吗?你们让我坐在黑人旁边，我不能坐在这么恶心的人旁边， 给我换个座位!"
乘务员很难解决这个问题，因为飞机几乎客满，但她还是告诉女士她会查询公务舱或 头等舱是否有空位。
几分钟后，乘务员带回了好消息。经济舱和公务舱全部客满，但头等舱还有一个座位。 乘务员说到这里时，那位女士禁不住自鸣得意地笑着看向周围的人。
乘务员接着说到：“这种情况下通常不会给乘客升舱，然而机长刚才有特别许可，他不 能接受我们的乘客要被迫坐在讨厌的人身边。"然后她对女士身边的乘客说：“所以如果 您愿意收拾行李，我们已为您准备好座位。"
周围的乘客全部起立鼓掌，黑人乘客换到了飞机前部的座位。

cards.audioText:
An aircraft broke due to some unexplained problems of the propeller.The pilot tried every method to repair but only to get more confused.So he had to call an experienced engineer to find out the problem.The engineer searched the engine carefully.It took a long time for the engineer to finish the checking procedure,
at last he only knocked the engine at a place then the engine was repaired well. The engineer charged the pilot for 5000 dollars,but the pilot was not willing
to pay for it since he thought that it was too expensive for just a knock.The
engineer was upset about the pilot's words for he didn't understand the value of engineers'work.He said,"It is inexpensive for a knock.A knock only values for 5 dollars,but knowing the correct place to knock values 4995 dollars."
cards.audioTextZh: 由于螺旋桨的问题飞机损坏，飞行员尝试用各种方法修理，但却只让自己更困惑，所 以他不得不叫一位有经验的工程师来解决问题。工程师仔细地检查发动机，检查程序 花费很长时间，最后工程师在发动机某处敲了敲，然后发动机就修好了。工程师向飞 行员收取5000美金的费用，但飞行员不愿意付，他认为敲一下飞机就收取这些费用太 贵了。工程师对此很失望，因为这说明飞行员不懂得工程师工作的价值。工程师说："修 理费并不贵，敲一次只需5美金，但知道敲一次的正确位置价值4995美金。"

cards.audioText:
A worker in the airport just finished his work,while he was walking along the
apron he found a female pilot was struggling with a huge package.The package was stuck,half of the package was in the plane and another half was out.The
worker was a very kind and warmhearted man,so he tried to help the female
pilot.He went into the plane and tried his best to push the package,but the
package did not move and nothing happened.Later the worker and the pilot
decided to push and pull at the same time.They tried so hard over and over
again and both got exhausted,but they still couldn't move the package.The worker felt hopeless and he said it was impossible to get the package out of the plane.Then he heard the pilot shrieking,"Oh,no!I was trying to stuff it in!"
cards.audioTextZh: 一位机场工人刚结束工作，他在停机坪看到一位女飞行员正在费力处理一个大包裹。 包裹被卡住，一半在飞机内一半在飞机外。这位工人很热心，所以他想帮助这个女飞 行员。他走到机舱内并尽力将包裹向外推，但是包裹根本没有挪动。之后，工人和飞 行员决定一个人推的同时另一个人拉。他们一次次努力，两个人都很累，但仍然没有 挪动包裹。工人感到很绝望，他说包裹可能没办法从飞机里拿出来了，然后他听到了 飞行员的大叫："不!我是想将包裹放进去!"

cards.audioText:
Lately I was on a VFR flight.we were passing within Aerodrome Traffic Zone
under the control of Local Approach,visibility was good,and there was not too much traffic on the frequency.
The controller requested a position report by asking if we were over an Island,the
feature cannot be found on the half million chart and I was not familiar with it.
So I looked for it and asked for clarification.During the period a potential Airprox
developed.Fortunately the pilot noted it and avoided it by an evasive maneuver.
The pilot and I were both annoyed by the controller for using an unrecognizable
local feature which caused confusion and distraction for us.We were squawking
7000 Mode C,so our position should be known.If not,or if there were too much
traffic on screen,the controller should have asked for a specific squawk.
Controllers should know that non-local pilots only navigate according to charted
features.To avoid accidents,local knowledge should be taken seriously.
cards.audioTextZh:
最近在一次目视飞行时，我们在当地进近的指挥下通过机场活动区域，能见度很好， 频率里也没有很多飞机。
管制员要我们报位置报，询问我们是否飞过某个岛，我在地形图上看不到这个岛，我 对这里的地形也并不熟悉，所以我试图寻找这个地形并要求管制员进行说明。在这期间， 飞机险些与其它飞机相撞。幸运的是，飞行员通过规避机动避免了事故。
飞行员和我都很恼火，由于管制员在指挥时使用无法找到的当地地形，导致我们很迷 惑并为此分神。我们的应答机是C 模式，编码7000,所以管制员应该知道飞机的位置。 如果管制员不知道，或屏幕上有太多活动，管制员应向我们要求特定的编码。
管制员要了解，非当地的飞行员只能根据图表上的地形导航。为避免事故发生，要谨 慎使用当地知识进行指挥。

cards.audioText:
The flight was flying to UK,and before landing,we were asked to hold at FL150 for approximately 30 minutes delay due to the weather.
The ATC first instructed us to hold at a level around FL100 and the next clearance

The situation was embarrassing.I had to apologize on the radio telephone and ATC responded,"No problem",with updated heading and further descent.
However,that airport was not the place to be at the wrong level and heading on a busy,rough Sunday night!
In the days following,by giving the incident much thought,I found the major contributing factor of my mistake.We were not supposed to hear what we
thought we should hear,thus confusing heading and cleared level.Instead,we should pay attention to the ATC instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机正飞往英国。着陆前，由于天气，我们要在高度层150等待30分钟左右。
ATC 首先指挥我们在高度层100等待，我们认为下个指令应该是下降到更低高度，当我 们接近高度层80时，ATC询问我们是否转向航向080。
这种情况让人很为难，我不得不在通话时道歉，ATC 回复：“没关系”,然后告知我修正 后的航向和下降高度。然而，在繁忙的周日晚，错误的高度层和航向会让飞机无法到 达机场!
接下来的几天中，我对这件事思考了很多，并找到出现错误的主要原因。我们不应假 设自己会收到什么指令，从而会弄混航向和高度。相反，我们应关注ATC给出的指令。

cards.audioText:
John was the captain of a flight from Shanghai to Hong Kong.On July 20th,
he and his first officer,Ted,controlled the airplane to take off from Shanghai
airport.When the plane reached 1200 feet,a windshear warning occurred with the warning sound echoed in the cockpit.Under that circumstances,John took over the control immediately and called for the checklist.The result showed the left PFD indicated normally and only a malfunction indication appeared on the right seat PFD.The flight crew came to an agreement it was a false warning,
so they continued to climb.The plane safely landed on Hong Kong airport 3
hours later.The crew asked a ground maintenance personnel to fix the problem. Unfortunately,on the way back,the same trouble appeared again.

John
cards.audioTextZh:
John是一架上海飞往香港航班的机长。7月20日，他和副驾驶Ted操纵飞机从上海机场起飞。飞机爬升到1,200英尺时出现风切变警告，警报声在驾驶舱内响起。John立即接管操纵并要求执行检查单。检查结果显示，左座主飞行显示器指示正常，只有右座主飞行显示器出现故障指示。机组一致判断这是一次虚假警告，因此继续爬升。

3小时后，飞机在香港机场安全着陆。机组请地面维修人员排除故障。遗憾的是，在返程途中同样的故障再次出现。

cards.audioText:
18.During a flight from Hong Kong to Beijing,we captured an urgency call from
UAL320 that they had a bird strike.A bird crashed their left windshield and the captain was badly wounded by the broken glass,so they requested for priority landing and ambulance.We informed this serious incident to the controller.The controller contacted the UAL320 at once without receiving any response.So
we were asked to relay the instruction to UAL320.Luckily,we contacted them
successfully,"UAL320,CCA830,Beijing Approach cleared you ILS straight in
approach runway 16R,you are number one,ambulance and first aid will be ready for you.""Roger,thank you very much”,the UAL320 replied.Finally,the aircraft landed on Beijing airport safely and the captain was sent to hospital immediately. There were no other people injured on the airplane.
cards.audioTextZh: 在香港飞往北京途中，我们接到来自美联航320的紧急呼叫，他们的飞机遭遇鸟击。有 鸟撞到左边挡风玻璃，玻璃破损，机长受重伤，所以他们请求优先着陆和救护车。我 们将这起严重事故告诉管制员，管制员立刻联系美联航320,但没有收到任何回复。于 是管制员要求我们传送指令给美联航320。幸运的是，我们与美联航320成功建立联系， "美联航320,国航830,北京进近同意直接盲降进近跑道16右，你是第一个，救护车 和急救已就位。""收到，非常感谢。”美联航320这样回复我们。飞机最终在北京机场安 全着陆，机长被立刻送往医院，机上没有其他人员受伤。

cards.audioText:
19.I still remember my solo day.On that day,the vice president of the United States was driven to the airport.Air force 2,a new B757,landed at about 9o'clock but we had to wait until all the formalities were completed on the apron.My CFI had asked me if I was ready for solo.At that time I said yes because of my confidence, and the clear weather also helped,but when I got into the cockpit and knew
the CFI wasn't coming,I still felt a bit nervous and I hoped not to screw it up. Everything was as usual and it was even better for me to notice that the plane had a better climb rate and there was a lot more room in the C150 with only
one person.Everything went by the book except when I lost mic on the floor and stumbled with repeated clearance of the option.Three landings seemed better than the once I did when the CFI was with me.The airplane finally safely landed with everything going smoothly.On my way home I thought about this experience of flying a real airplane alone.To have the vice president fly all that way just watch me solo gave me more confidence about myself.
cards.audioTextZh: 到现在我还能想起单飞那天的经历。那天，美国副总统到达机场。空军二号，一架全 新波音757,在9点左右着陆，但我们必须在机坪等待所有仪式完成。我的总飞行教练 之前询问我是否已准备好单飞，由于对自己有信心，并且天气条件好，我回答没问题。 但当我走进驾驶舱得知总飞行教练不在时，我还是感到有些紧张，并且希望我不会犯 错误。飞行一切正常，我甚至感到飞机有更好的爬升率，单独一个人在塞斯纳150上显 得舱内很空旷。所有事情都按照检查单执行除了我把麦克风掉在了地上而且蹩脚的重 复执行了许可选项。这三个落地比之前跟总飞行教练飞得都要好。最终，飞机安全降落， 飞行顺利。回家的路上，我在回想这次单独飞行的经历。副总统特地赶过来看我单飞 这件事情上给了我莫大的自信。

cards.audioText:
20.The flight was from New York to Dallas.When passengers were boarding,an
elderly couple found a woman occupied their seats in first class.The flight
attendant wanted to see her boarding pass to solve the problem,but the woman responded in fake broken English,"No English,pas anglais."
The attendant knew it was a pretence because the woman had been chatting a bit with another passenger.Then,she tried to persuade the woman to show the boarding pass but only to get disregard.At last,she had to use French to talk
with the woman.The woman was so surprised that she let go of her ticket and gave it to the attendant.After checking the boarding pass,the attendant walked the woman all the way to her seat which was at the back of the plane,then she returned to first class.
During the flight,the woman continued complaining in French and asking that attendant to serve her.The attendant smiled and served her everything she wanted,but talked with her in English as she spoke in French.
Finally,the flight landed safely at Dallas.The woman was one of the last people off the plane.She demanded the attendant's name and worker ID so she could complain about her.Unexpectedly,the attendant smiled and told the woman it would be nice if she stopped pretending that she couldn't speak or understand English.The woman scowled and marched off the plane.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架飞机从纽约飞往达拉斯。登机时，一对老夫妇发现一位女士坐在他们的头等舱座 位上。乘务员想检查她的登机牌，但她用蹩脚的英语回复："不会英语。"
乘务员知道这是借口，因为她之前在用英语和另一位乘客交谈。之后，乘务员想劝说 女士出示登机牌，但是她完全不理。最后，乘务员不得不用法语和她交流，她非常惊 讶于是放手把票给了乘务员。检查完登机牌后，乘务员带领女士走到她位于飞机后部 的座位，然后乘务员回到了头等舱。
整个飞行期间，这位女士一直在用法语抱怨并要求那位乘务员为她提供服务。乘务员 微笑着满足她的要求，但始终用英语回复她的法语。
最终飞机在达拉斯安全降落，这位女士是最后下飞机的乘客们之一，她想知道乘务员 的名字和证件号去投诉。意外的是，乘务员微笑着告诉她，如果她能不再假装不懂英 语就好了。这位女士皱着眉走下了飞机。

cards.audioText:
A ridiculous accident happened when a flight was coming back from Poland in
1998.The plane had just landed at the airport when a guy on board claimed
that he had a bomb.All the passengers started to panic.The pilot immediately
contacted ATC and asked for emergency services.Because of the man's allegation the plane couldn't get to the gate,so the plane had to board on a bus.All the
luggage on the plane was removed and sniffed by a dog.The flight crew and
passengers waited and watched for3 hours without air conditioning and food or anything.After searching,it turned out that there was no bomb on board.The guy was just drunk,and he went mad because they wouldn't give him another beer.

1998
cards.audioTextZh:
1998年，一架从波兰返航的飞机上发生了一起荒唐事件。飞机刚在机场着陆，一名机上乘客就声称自己携带炸弹，所有乘客顿时陷入恐慌。飞行员立即联系空中交通管制并请求应急服务。

由于这名男子声称机上有炸弹，飞机无法驶向登机口，乘客只得转乘摆渡车。机上所有行李都被卸下，并由嗅探犬检查。机组和乘客在没有空调、食物或其他保障的情况下等待并观看排查过程长达3小时。

检查结果显示机上根本没有炸弹。那名男子只是喝醉了，因为机组不肯再给他一杯啤酒而失控闹事。

cards.audioText:
Before the flight,a man used his miles to upgrade to first class.He thought this would make his flight much more comfortable than usual,but what happened later proved he was wrong.He sat next to an old lady whose family members
were in economy class.Soon after take-off,when the man was about to begin eating,the old lady suddenly and explosively vomited.The flight attendant
rushed to her to deal with the situation,but the old lady did not turn better.
Another half an hour later,when the man was stepping around her to use the
restroom,she vomited again and some of her vomits even got on the man'
s clothes.After cleaning himself out in the restroom,the man came back and
found his seat was crowded with the lady's family members.Because of the
crowd,he was asked to simply stand and wait during 40 minutes of turbulence, and during that time the sick lady vomited yet again.That whole area smelled terrible.Passengers couldn't just stand while the plane landed,so the man had to exchange his seat with the lady's niece whose seat was in economy class.The worst is,when the man asked if he could get his miles back,he was told"NO" .The man was not satisfied and he thought this unforgettable flying experience was a total nightmare.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前，一位男士用里程升到头等舱。他原以为这次飞行会比以前更舒适，但后来发 生的事证明了他的选择是错的。他的座位在一位老妇人旁边，老妇人的家人全都在经 济舱。起飞后不久，当他准备用餐时，老妇人猛地呕吐起来。乘务员很快来处理完这 个情况，但老妇人的情况并没有转好。半小时后，这位男士从老妇人身边经过去洗手间， 这时老妇人再次呕吐起来，有些呕吐物甚至弄到了他的衣服上。在洗手间清理完，他 发现自己的座位附近挤满了老妇人的家人。由于人太多，飞机颠簸的40分钟里他只能 站着等待，在这期间老妇人再次呕吐起来，整个区域弥漫着可怕的味道。飞机着陆时 乘客必须坐下，所以他只能和在经济舱的老妇人的侄女换座位。更糟糕的是，他升舱 的里程无法返还。他为此感到很不满意，他认为这次经历简直是个噩梦。

cards.audioText:
During a flight from Rhode Island to Washington,an accident happened and brought bad influence on the airline.The aircraft took off from the airport
smoothly and the flight was incident-free en route.When the plane was
approaching to the airport,the pilot was tired so he missed the controller'
s instruction.Then the controller gave the instruction again.This time,the
pilot became clear but he applied the brakes suddenly.Because of his sudden operation,the back door of the plane blew off and passengers could see the runway.Fortunately,the cabin had already lost the pressure so no one flew out and all the passengers stayed in their own seats safely.However,the pilot was grounded because of his misoperation.
cards.audioTextZh: 罗德岛飞往华盛顿的航班上发生一起事故，这起事故给航空公司带来不好的影响。飞 机从机场顺利起飞，途中也没有事故发生。飞机进近时，飞行员因为疲劳漏听管制员 指令。之后管制员再次给出指令，这时飞行员清醒了并突然刹车。因为突然的操作， 飞机的后门被吸走，乘客们能直接看到跑道。幸运的是客舱已降压，没有人因此吸出 飞机，乘客们都安全待在座位上。然而，飞行员由于这次失误被停飞。

cards.audioText:
The flight was from Seattle to Vancouver.After checking the radar,the pilot
requested push back and start up.The airplane was approved to push back and start up but few seconds later the controller found the left engine of the plane got fire.So he gave the pilot a warning immediately and asked if fire service
was needed.The pilot shut off the engine immediately to prevent the fire from spreading."The emergency equipment is standing by."the controller told the pilot.Several minutes later,passengers were all safely evacuated.There was no one injured but passengers had to change to another airline.
cards.audioTextZh:
该航班从西雅图飞往温哥华。检查雷达后，飞行员请求推出和启动发动机。飞机获准推出开车，但几秒钟后，管制员发现飞机左发起火，立即向飞行员发出警告，并询问是否需要消防服务。

飞行员立即关闭发动机，防止火势蔓延。管制员告知飞行员：“应急设备正在待命。”几分钟后，所有乘客安全撤离，无人受伤，但乘客不得不改乘另一家航空公司的航班。

cards.audioText:
25.It was a foggy day in 2001,A Flight 126 from Singapore Airlines was cleared to
taxi to runway 19 Right.A few minutes later,a Cessna pilot requested engine
start,and the ground controller gave start-up clearance.Then the controller
asked 126 to contact the Tower controller.From then on,those two aircraft were
on two different radio frequencies.The Cessna started to taxi,but the pilot made
the mistake of taxiing to the right and entered taxiway Echo 6.But the Ground
controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi.At the

entered the active runway 19 Right.Unfortunately,the two aircraft collided,all
124 people on board died.

2001
cards.audioTextZh:
2001年的一个大雾天，新加坡航空126号航班获准滑行至19右跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布开车许可，随后要求126号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。

塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右转，进入Echo 6滑行道。地面管制员没有发现这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可126号航班起飞。126号航班在跑道上加速滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过跑道等待标志，进入正在使用的19右跑道。两架飞机不幸相撞，机上124人全部遇难。

cards.audioText:
A strong snowstorm hit Chicago International airport in an afternoon.An aircraft from United Airlines circled several times before attempting to land at the airport. The snowstorm had reduced visibility severely.The runway visual range was
at 4,500 feet below the landing minimums for the ILS approach to Runway 13
Center.The controller advised the crew to hold in the air,waiting for the weather to get better,or to divert to another airport with a longer runway.But both
suggestions would produce large additional expense for the airline,as well as
inconvenience of the flight's passengers.So the crew decided to circle to land
on runway 31 Center,which had lower landing minimums.But unfortunately,the strong tailwind made the plane skid off the runway and crash into a stopping
truck.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日下午，一场暴风雪袭击了芝加哥国际机场。一架美联航飞机准备在机场着陆，但 由于能见度极低，飞机不得不在机场上空盘旋。跑道视程为4500英尺，低于13中跑道 的盲降进近标准。管制员建议机组空中等待天气好转，或备降到有较长跑道的另一机 场着陆，但是这两种选择均会额外增加公司成本，并给乘客带来不便，于是考虑再三， 机组决定在有着较低着陆标准的31中跑道盘旋着陆。很遗憾，强顺风使飞机滑出跑道， 撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

cards.audioText:
An air traffic controller issued a take-off clearance to the Flight 386 for runway 30R.At the same time,an airport operations officer was operating a vehicle on that runway.The controller had previously issued a clearance to the operations officer to conduct bird dispersal activities on the runway.The operations officer was monitoring his radio and heard Flight 386's take-off clearance.He told the controller that he would vacate the runway.At the same time,the flight crew had observed the vehicle on the runway and did not commence the takeoff.
The controller cancelled the take-off clearance until the runway was clear.The investigation found that the controller didn't keep eyes on the runway because he was concentrating on heavy traffic.Another possible reason was that the
controller was experiencing some degree of fatigue at the time.
cards.audioTextZh: 一管制员发布起飞许可给386航班，允许该飞机从跑道30右起飞，与此同时，一名机 场工作人员正在30右跑道上工作。因为之前管制员让该工作人员在跑道上驱鸟。工作 人员在当前频率守听，听到386航班要起飞的许可指令，立刻告诉管制员他会马上离开 跑道。同时，机组人员看到跑道上的车辆，没有执行起飞操作。管制员取消了起飞许可， 直到跑道被空出来。后据调查，管制员因为指挥飞机过多，没有留意该跑道，导致了 这次事件。还有一个可能的原因是管制员此时过于疲惫导致此次事件。

cards.audioText:
Getting lost as an airplane flying is a potentially dangerous situation,especially
when low on fuel.If a pilot becomes lost,there are some good common sense
procedures to follow.If a town or city cannot be seen,the first thing to do is
climb.Being mindful of traffic and weather conditions.An increase in altitude
increases radio and navigation reception range,and also increases radar coverage. If flying near a town or city,it might be possible to read the name of the town
on a water tower.If the airplane has a navigation radio,such as a VOR or ADF
receiver,it can be possible to determine position by plotting an azimuth from two or more navigational facilities.If GPS is installed or a pilot has a portable aviation GPS on board,it can be used to determine the position and location of the
nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在飞行中迷航是一种潜在的危险情况，特别是在燃料不足的情况下。如果飞行员 迷航，可以遵循一些良好的常识程序。如果无法目视某个城镇或城市，首要的就是爬升。 留意其他航空器及天气情况。海拔高度的增加使得无线电和导航的接收范围扩大，也 增加了雷达覆盖范围。如果在一个城镇或城市附近飞行，可能会在水塔上看到城镇的 名字。如果飞机配备无线电导航，如VOR 或ADF 接收器，它可以通过两个或更多的导 航设施绘制方位角来确定位置。如果安装了全球定位系统(GPS), 或者飞行员在飞机上 配备了便携式航空全球定位系统，就可以确定最近机场的方位和位置。

cards.audioText:
It was a foggy day in 2002,SIA 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R.A few
minutes later,the Cessna pilot requested engine start.The ground controller
gave start-up clearance.Then he requested Flight 626 to contact the Tower
controller.From then on,those two aircraft were on two different radio
frequencies.The Cessna started to taxi,but the pilot made a mistake of taxiing to right and entered taxiway R6.But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi.At the same time,the Tower controller cleared Flight 626 for takeoff.When the flight 626 was rolling on the runway,
the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately,the two aircraft collided,all 114 people on board died.

2002
cards.audioTextZh:
2002年的一个大雾天，新加坡航空626号航班获准滑行至36右跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布开车许可，随后要求626号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。

塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右转并进入R6滑行道。地面管制员没有发现这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可626号航班起飞。626号航班在跑道上起飞滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过跑道等待标志，进入正在使用的36右跑道。两架飞机不幸相撞，机上114人全部遇难。

cards.audioText:
Flight 145 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and
runway 22.There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft.But it was
regarded as the most serious incident of this kind.That day,the tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22.But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16.After Flight 145 touched down,the ground radar system alerted.The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16.However,the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection.It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145.The two aircraft
missed colliding by only 50 feet.

145
cards.audioTextZh:
145号航班在16号跑道与22号跑道交叉处险些与101号航班相撞。两架飞机均无人受伤，机体也没有损坏，但该事件被认为是此类事件中最严重的一次。

当天，塔台管制员许可145号航班在22号跑道着陆；但在许可101号航班从与其相交的16号跑道起飞时，管制员忘记了这架正在进场的飞机。145号航班接地后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指令145号航班在16号跑道外等待，但飞机最终只能停在跑道交叉口中央。

此时101号航班已无法中断起飞，只能提前离地，从145号航班上方飞过。两架飞机最近时仅相差50英尺，险些相撞。

cards.audioText:
When an American Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its
destination,the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12.The tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12
at that time,so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for
runway 30.But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller
cleared them to land on that runway.The runway was wet and the braking action was not good.During landing roll,the aircraft skidded to the right side of the
runway and went through the airport fences.The fuselage was broken into three pieces,the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft.No one was killed,but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.

cards.audioTextZh: 当一架美国航空815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近管制中心，要求在12 跑道盲降进近。当时12跑道报告有顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员在30跑道盘旋进 近。但机组人员坚持在12跑道降落，管制员允许他们在该跑道降落。跑道湿滑，刹车 性能也不好。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机侧滑到跑道右侧，穿过机场围栏。机身断成三段， 右发和右主起落架与机身分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText:
One day,Flight 456,a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to
land at Tokyo International Airport.When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach,flight 456 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion.During the holding,the flight crew was informed that the
local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the pilot to divert
to the alternate,but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the
alternate.So the controller vectored flight 456 by radar to land at runway 34R.
Unfortunately,the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizers due to wind shear.Flight 456 went around and made a second approach.Later,it crashed
into a hillside due to fuel shortage.The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.referenceText: 和树袋熊一样，树袋熊31一样，音频用【树袋熊34】
cards.audioTextZh:
一天，一架载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的B737 执行456航班在东京国际机场降落。
当从东京区调转到东京进近时，因为航空器拥堵，456航班被指示前往DA等待。在等 待期间，机组人员被告知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降，但飞行员报告 说他们的燃料不够备降。所以管制员雷达引导456航班降落在34右跑道。不幸的是，
由于风切变，飞行员无法在航道上建立稳定进近。456航班执行了复飞，执行了二次进近。 后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机在山坡上坠毁。飞机被撞成碎片，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText:
When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control,
the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1.The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency.However,the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency.Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change,they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later,the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the
company dispatcher,they got no response from the pilots.The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh:
当新航128接近芝加哥中心区域管制时，管制员指示机组人员切换频率到下一扇区
132.1。副驾驶确认了切换的频率并进行了复诵。然而，机组人员并没有在新的频率中 与管制员建立联系。由于管制员正处于交接班时间，他们不知道128次航班没有建立无 线电联系，30分钟后，下一扇区的管制员在雷达上发现了新航128。尽管他们试图通过 联系公司签派与飞机建立联系，但飞行员仍没有回应。50分钟后，在紧急频率上管制 员终于恢复了与新航128的联系。

Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers.One day,a
B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing.It was then cleared to
cross runway 36R.But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R.The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply.He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off.This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R.So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R.Suddenly,the
controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move.Realizing the risk of runway incursion,he canceled A320s takeoff clearance immediately.

Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher， they got no responsefrom the pilots. The controller finally regainedcontact with SIA188 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新加坡航空公司188号航班（SIA188）接近芝加哥中心区域管制的空域时，管制员指示机组人员将下一段航程的无线电频率切换至132.1。副驾驶确认了频率变更，并正确复诵了该频率。然而，机组人员并未在新频率上与空中交通管制（ATC）取得联系。由于接收单位的管制员当时正在准备交接班，他们并不知道188号航班没有建立无线电联系。30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新加坡航空公司188号航班。尽管他们尝试通过呼叫该公司的调度员来与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。最终，管制员在50分钟后通过应急频率重新与新加坡航空公司188号航班取得了联系。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day， a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R. But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R. The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraftlanding lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure andhad not received the clearance to cross runway36R. So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R. Suddenly， the controller noticed the B757＇s lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion， he canceled A320s takeoff clearanceimmediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯信号可以为管制员提供有用的信息。有一 天，一架B757飞机在着陆后经滑行道A9从36左跑道脱离。然后它又被允许可以穿36右跑道。但 它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9滑行道上停止了 滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员，但没有得到 回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也熄灭了，这使他确认 B757出现了无线电故障，没有收到通过36右跑 道的许可指令。因此他指挥另外一架A320在36 右跑道上起飞。突然，管制员注意到B757的灯又 亮了，它开始移动。意识到有发生跑道入侵的危 险，管制员立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002， SIA 686 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R. A few minuteslater， the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 686 to contact the Tower controller. From then on， those two aircraft were on two different radiofrequencies. The Cessna started to taxi， but the pilot made a mistake to taxi to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controllerdid not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time， the Towercontroller cleared Flight 686 for takeoff. Whenthe flight 686 was rolling on the runway， theCessna crossed the runway holding sign andentered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately，the two aircraft collided， all 114 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年的一个雾天，新加坡航空公司686号航班获许滑行至36R跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机。地面管制员给予了启动许可。然后，他让686号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机就处于两个不同的无线电频率上。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右滑行，进入了R6滑行道。然而，地面管制员并未意识到这一点，仍批准塞斯纳飞机继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准686号航班起飞。当686号航班在跑道上开始滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过了跑道等待标志，进入了正在使用的36R跑道。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上114人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: Flight 345 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day， the tower controller cleared Flight 345 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arrivingaircraft when he cleared Flight 10l to take offfrom the intersecting runway 16.After Flight 345 touched down， the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight345 to stop short of runway 16. However， theaircraft managed to stop in the middle of theintersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 toabort takeoff. Flight 101 made an early liftoffand flew over Flight 345. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 345航班和101航班在16号跑道与22号跑道的交叉处险些相撞。两架飞机均未出现人员伤亡情况，机体也都没有受损。但这起事件仍被视为此类事件中最为严重的一起。当天，塔台管制员批准345航班在22号跑道降落。然而，当他批准101航班从与之交叉的16号跑道起飞时，却忘记了正在进场降落的345航班。345航班触地降落之后，地面雷达系统发出了警报。管制员试图指示345航班在16号跑道前停下。然而，飞机最终在跑道交叉点的中央才停了下来。此时101航班已无法中止起飞程序，于是101航班提前离地升空，从345航班上方飞过。两架飞机仅差50英尺就相撞了。

cards.audioText: As American Flight 835 was approaching the terminal area of its destination， the flightcrew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time， so the controller advised thepilot to make a circling approach for runway30. But the crew insisted to land on runway 12and the controller cleared them to land on therunway 12. The runway was wet and braking action was not good. During landing roll， the aircraft skidded to the left of the runway and went through the airportfences. The fuselage was broken into threepieces， the right engine and tight main gearwere separated from the aircraft. No one waskilled， but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当美国835航班接近其目的地的终端区域时，飞行机组人员联系了进近管制部门，并请求使用仪表着陆系统（ILS）对12号跑道进行进近。当时报告显示12号跑道存在顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员对30号跑道进行盘旋进近。但机组人员坚持要在12号跑道降落，管制员便批准他们在12号跑道降落。跑道是湿的，制动效果不佳。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机向跑道左侧打滑，并冲出了机场围栏。机身断成了三截，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。所幸无人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: One day， Flight 123， a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach， flight 123 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding， the flight crew was informed that the local weather wasdeteriorating and the controller suggested thepilot diver to the alternate， but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to thealternate. So the controller vectored flight 123by radar to land at runway 34R.Unfortunately，the pilot couldn＇t stabilize the aircraft on thelocalizer due to wind shear. Flight 123 went around and made a second approach. Later， it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage.The aircraft was broken into pieces and all thepeople on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的波音737型123号航班正飞往东京国际机场准备降落。当该航班从东京区域管制移交给东京进近管制时，由于空中交通拥堵，123号航班接到指令前往DA点等待。在等待过程中，机组人员得知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降其他机场，但飞行员报告称燃油不足以支撑他们飞抵备降机场。于是，管制员通过雷达引导123号航班在34R跑道降落。不幸的是，由于遭遇风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在仪表着陆系统的航向道上保持稳定。123号航班复飞并进行了第二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机坠毁在一处山坡上。飞机解体，机上所有人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: One day， Indonesia 205 took off from Jinan toHangzhou. About one hour later， the aircraft was transferred to Hangzhou Approach. Hangzhou Approach required Indonesia 205 toslow down to 190 knots and later the controllerasked the pilot to reduce speed to 160 knots.Three minutes later， Indonesia 205 passed the outer marker inbound. At that time， the controller issued a missed approach clearancebecause of separation. He instructed Indonesia 205 to make a right turn to a heading of 180 and climb to 900m. But during the missed approach， the aircraft was out of control because of mechanical problem. The aircraft continued to descend with a high angle of attack. The aircraft impacted trees and buildings and part of the fuselage was damaged.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日，印尼205航班从济南起飞前往杭州。大约一小时后，该航班被移交给杭州进近管制。杭州进近管制要求印尼205航班将速度降至190节，随后管制员又要求飞行员将速度减至160节。三分钟后，印尼205航班在向台飞行时通过了远距指点标。当时，由于间隔问题，管制员发出了复飞指令。 他指示印尼205航班右转至航向180度，并爬升至900米。但在复飞过程中，飞机因机械故障失去控制。飞机以大迎角持续下降，撞上了树木和建筑物，部分机身受损。

cards.audioText: One day， AFR188 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L， but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway， and crashed into the fence of the airport. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed， and the co-pilot was badly injured. The plane was destroyed by the impact and caught on an intense fire. According to the investigation， there were three reasons leading to the accidents. First ofall， the crew didn＇t use effective methods to verify their position at the airport. Secondly， the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally， the crewmembers＇idle chatting during the taxi resulted in the loss of situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，法国航空公司188号航班（AFR188）在新加坡樟宜机场起飞时坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组人员在02L跑道起飞，但机组人员却在02R跑道排队并开始了起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道，撞上了机场的围栏。机组人员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶受了重伤。飞机因撞击而损毁，并燃起了熊熊大火。 根据调查，导致此次事故的原因有三个。首先，机组人员没有使用有效的方法来确认他们在机场的位置。其次，机组人员忘记检查他们是否在正确的跑道上。最后，机组人员在滑行过程中的闲聊导致他们对所处情况的认知缺失。

cards.audioText: One day， an A320 collided with a B737 during taxi.The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage of its left wing. Luckily， there were noinjuries. After receiving ATC taxi instruction， the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought theyhad enough room to pass over the B737.ButunfortunatelyFortunately， the fuel leak didn＇tdevelop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes applied when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh:
一天，一架空客A320在滑行过程中与一架波音737相撞。波音737的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼仅受到轻微损伤。所幸无人受伤。

收到空中交通管制的滑行指令后，空客A320开始从波音737右侧通过。空客A320机长认为两机之间有足够空间，可以越过波音737，但随后发生了碰撞。所幸燃油泄漏没有进一步引发火灾。

波音737机组表示，发生碰撞时他们的飞机一直停在原地，且已设置停留刹车，却遭到空客A320撞击。

cards.audioText:
A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800，
performirng flight XG-3208 from Burgas to
Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintainFL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing
737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from
Antalya to Bratislava was enroute at FL240
did not want to change their flight level. ATCinstructed XG-3208 to turn left onto a heading270. The crew however, read back "Climb
FL270", which was not picked up by ATC.
The crew selected FL270 into their Selected
Altitude, and this was duely transmitted by
Mode-S to the controller's desk, where a
disagree message appeared between clearedand assigned altitude. The aircraft began to
climb, about 15 seconds later, the radar issueda short term conflict alert between XG-3208
and 6D-6129.Then ATC instructed XG-3208 todescend back to FL220 immediately,4 secondslater the crew read that instruction back. Andthe aircraft already climbed through FL236.
The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and2.6nm horizontally and the aircraft continuedto climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing
vertical separation. ATC thus instructed
XG-3208 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh:
. 一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。

机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。

两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。
